About Jugaad

A different way of looking at problems.

Real-world problems rarely arrive in neat categories.

They may involve business decisions, commercial interests, people, property, institutions, creative thinking or practical execution — often all at once. Conventional solutions may not always address the actual situation.

Jugaad Advisory brings together independent thinking, practical experience and the ability to connect different areas of expertise around a specific challenge. It is an independent, founder-led practice, a brand of Guava Creative Solutions Private Limited.

What Jugaad means

Jugaad is often understood as resourcefulness: finding a way forward when conventional routes are inadequate. Here it does not mean cutting corners, compromising ethics or taking shortcuts. It means a fresh perspective, recognising overlooked resources, bringing the right people together and finding a responsible, practical way forward.

Jugaad is not about cutting corners. It is about finding a better way forward.

Our philosophy

We value resourcefulness, clarity, responsibility and practical thinking. We are interested in what can genuinely be done — not just what sounds good in a presentation. Good advice should help someone understand their choices and take a considered next step.

Experience across different worlds.

A practical approach to solving problems.

Jugaad Advisory is founder-led by Junaid Memon, an entrepreneur whose journey has crossed advertising, filmmaking, media, business development, agriculture, rural communication and environmental initiatives.

His experience includes work through Crystal Communications, Nomad Films and Guava Creative Solutions, as well as Green TV India, a farmer-focused broadcasting initiative. He has also been associated with ARDEAF Foundation (Agriculture Rural Development & Environment Awareness Foundation), focused on agriculture, rural development and environmental awareness.

The approach comes from this variety: understand the situation, look beyond the obvious, identify what is possible and bring the relevant people together. Assignments are approached individually, with specialists and associates involved where their experience is relevant.

Space reserved for a short founder’s note, to be written by Junaid Memon himself.

What we are not

Jugaad Advisory is not a one-size-fits-all consultancy. It is not a law firm, engineering consultancy, architectural practice, investment bank or regulated brokerage. Where an assignment requires licensed, regulated or specialist services, those are provided by appropriately qualified and authorised professionals. Our role may involve strategy, coordination, problem-solving, evaluation, introductions and bringing the relevant people together.

Have a problem that needs a different perspective?

Tell us what you are dealing with. It does not have to fit neatly into one category. Sometimes the first step towards a solution is simply having the right conversation.
